manualReview.description: Every intermediate leg runs with no minimum: router.exchange(..., _expected=0, ...) per yield token (L318), V4 swap exact-input with sqrtPriceLimitX96 = MAX_SQRT_PRICE-1 i.e. no price bound (L328-336), and sya.claim(nftIndex, 0, exempt) (L285). harvest() has no deadline parameter. Pattern conditions 'amountOutMin = 0' and 'no deadline' are met; 'user cannot specify minimum' is NOT met: the single aggregate minEthOut check (L249) is an atomic end-to-end bound, and the operator script sets minEthOut = max(simEthOut*(1-50bps), gas floor) and submits via a private relay (script/harvest.sh L12, L234-247, L255+). Sandwich value at risk is only the caller's own harvest profit; SYA's payment is fixed at par from skimSurplus and is not affected by the sale price, so no protocol/third-party value is exposed. Downgraded from pattern HIGH for that reason.

manualReview.description: ethOut = address(this).balance (L248) pays the WHOLE ETH balance to msg.sender, and surplus = IERC20(reward).balanceOf(address(this)) - owed (L291) swaps the WHOLE reward-token balance; the NFT refund returns the WHOLE balance of nftIndex (L242-244); _sellYield sells the WHOLE balance of each strategy token (L312). Matches 'contract balance paid out', 'recipient caller-chosen', 'payout not compared to contribution'. Also SELFDESTRUCT-FORCE-ETH (balance-dependent logic). Mitigating context: the contract is stateless between calls, receive() only accepts ETH from the PoolManager (L297-299), so any pot is stray value left by a third party (forced ETH, PoolManager.take donations, mistaken ERC20/ERC1155 transfers, V4 partial-fill leftovers if the price limit were ever reached). That is user-error value captured by the next caller, not an attack on honest users. Stray ETH can also make a gas-unprofitable harvest pass the Unprofitable check (benign). No rescue/sweep function exists, so mistakenly-sent assets are recoverable only by whoever harvests next.
mitigationsFound: stateless contract; receive() restricted to PoolManager; design decision documented in harvest() NatSpec (whole-balance NFT refund)
missingMitigations: no owner sweep for mistakenly-sent assets

manualReview.description: Balance-based branching in _sellYield (L312-315): for each non-exempt strategy token, a non-zero harvester balance with no registered route reverts RouteNotConfigured, and any non-zero balance is routed through Curve Router NG. An unprivileged griefer can donate 1 wei of a non-exempt strategy token (e.g. a token whose strategy delivered nothing this round, a token paused in SYA, or a registered strategy whose route the owner has not set) to force either RouteNotConfigured or a dust Curve exchange that may revert in some pool types (e.g. StableSwap-NG `dy = xp[j] - y - 1` underflow / ERC4626 zero-share deposit). Because the dust persists (no sweep), the DoS persists until a harvest sells it or the caller passes the strategy in exemptStrategies. Workaround exists (exempt the strategy; it had no yield anyway), and harvest.sh exempt list is manual, so impact is liveness/operator friction only. The DB pattern's spot-price conditions (critical spot-price decision, no TWAP) are NOT met: the harvester uses no price oracle and SYA prices claims at par from skimSurplus.
mitigationsFound: caller can exempt the strategy; a strategy delivering real yield sells the dust together with its yield
missingMitigations: no dust threshold / no skip on unrouted dust

manualReview.description: safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, nftIndex, bal, '') (L244) invokes msg.sender.onERC1155Received AFTER the unlock has produced the ETH and BEFORE ethOut = address(this).balance is read (L248) and paid (L254); harvest() has no nonReentrant. A re-entrant harvest from the hook would read and pay out the outer call's ETH. Conditions 'no reentrancy guard' and 'hook can re-enter' are met, but there is no victim: the hook runs only in the caller's own contract, the ETH in flight belongs to that same caller, the PoolManager unlock and SYA claim (nonReentrant) have already completed, and the harvester holds no other state. A nested unlock during the callback is impossible (AlreadyUnlocked). Inbound pull (L236) hits the harvester's own ERC1155Holder hook only.
mitigationsFound: stateless contract; ETH only exists transiently for the current caller; SYA.claim nonReentrant; V4 single-unlock
missingMitigations: no reentrancy guard (not needed given statelessness)

nonPatternObservations.description: Run-01 OBS-01 (last-non-zero end check vs first-empty-pool termination; = ledger M-01 004d4547d9 fix-pending) is resolved at path level by the 6b862aa rewrite: k derived from first empty pool slot (L161-162), InvalidRouteGap on any entry after the executed prefix (L164-166), InvalidRouteToken on zero executed intermediates (L168-170), InvalidRouteEnd on delivered=path[2k] (L171-173), and unexecuted swapParams rows / pools forced zero (L176-185). Spot-reproduced this session: reports/02/profiles/evidence/route-validator-model.py -> "accepted but router not delivering R: 1", the single case being the k=0 reward-token route [R,0x10] which reverts in Router NG (never executed: _sellYield skips the reward token, L356). Zero accepted routes deliver a non-reward token, so the silent strand cannot recur. ETH-ending routes (receive() NotPoolManager) are also now rejected via InvalidRouteEnd since delivered must equal rewardToken. Residual over-acceptance is fail-loud only: see OBS-05.

nonPatternObservations.description: Executed rows require only swapParams[h][2] != 0. Deployed Router NG v1.1 (0x16C6...) dispatches swap_type 1..8 and raises "Bad swap type" otherwise, so swap_type >= 9 is stored and reverts every harvest selling that token. i/j/pool_type/n_coins and executed-hop pools are unconstrained by design (story-007 out-of-scope); a wrong i/j reverts in Router NG ("Received nothing"). All consequences are loud reverts, no strand, no value at risk; caller can exempt the strategy. Same as profile LOCAL-006/LOCAL-007. Not a pattern-DB match (closest: INCORRECT-OPERATOR, but not a deadline/threshold boundary). Hand to code-scanner as QA/Low.

Unchanged root: routes and ethPool validated against sya.rewardToken() at set time only; unlockCallback reads it live (L325). Run-02 extension: the canonical k=0 route stored for the then-current reward token becomes reachable after SYA setRewardToken if a strategy delivers the old token, and reverts inside Router NG with empty revert data that harvest.sh cannot decode. Fail-loud liveness; cross-owner footgun (Law 3). Same as profile LOCAL-005; ledger L-03-related.

All deltas net to zero for a non-hooked pool; hook deltas are included in the returned BalanceDelta. Callback access control: msg.sender==poolManager and V4 only calls back the unlock caller, so the check is sufficient. int128 negation/casting paths cannot be reached with wrong signs for exact-input. No pattern match.

nonPatternObservations.description: owed = calculateClaimAmount*1.01; allowance to SYA is exactly owed and reset to 0. SYA charges actualPayment computed from skimSurplus at par minus discount; if actualPayment > owed, SYA's transferFrom reverts (loud). Sale price does not affect SYA's receipt; a yield-token depeg below (1-discount) makes harvest revert via surplus underflow (loud). Donation into a strategy to inflate skim is unprofitable (attacker pays (1-d) for value it donated). No FLASH-LOAN-PRICE condition in the harvester.
